title: Online gas classification at the edge
abstract: arXiv:2610.36999v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Field applications in chemical sensing, from portable safety monitors to mobile robots, require models that are lightweight, fast to respond, and can be recalibrated from limited labelled data. Current gas classification pipelines assume controlled sampling cycles and offline feature extraction, and rely on computationally expensive models. With a few thousand neurons and sub-milliwatt power consumption, insects reliably classify odours in open environments. Inspired by the insect olfactory system, we present a neural network architecture that classifies raw sensor array readings using a sparse, high-dimensional binary representation. We evaluate it on random sequences of single gases and binary mixtures, introducing new samples dynamically and classifying gas identity from the transient sensor response. translated_title: 边缘端的在线气体分类
translated_abstract: 化学传感领域的实际应用，从便携式安全监测器到移动机器人，都需要轻量化、响应快速、并且能够基于有限标注数据进行重新校准的模型。当前的气体分类流程假设采样周期可控、特征提取离线进行，并且依赖于计算开销高昂的模型。昆虫仅用几千个神经元和亚毫瓦级的功耗，就能在开放环境中可靠地对气味进行分类。受昆虫嗅觉系统的启发，我们提出了一种神经网络架构，该架构使用稀疏的高维二进制表示对原始传感器阵列读数进行分类。我们在单种气体和二元混合物的随机序列上对该架构进行评估，动态引入新样本，并从传感器的瞬态响应中识别气体种类。在这一设定下，该架构在气体混合物分类上优于线性支持向量机（SVM），并与经过优化的非线性支持向量机性能相当，同……（原文截断）
tldr: 受昆虫嗅觉系统启发，本文提出一种基于稀疏高维二进制表示的轻量神经网络架构，能够在边缘设备上从原始传感器瞬态响应中在线识别气体，性能媲美优化的非线性SVM，且适用于功耗和样本受限的真实场景。
en_tdlr: Inspired by the insect olfactory system, this paper presents a lightweight neural network architecture that uses sparse high-dimensional binary representations to classify gases online from raw transient sensor responses on edge devices, matching an optimized non-linear SVM while being suitable for power- and data-constrained real-world scenarios.
